[Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian)

## Appearance

Lorna is described as a bright and lovely woman with ocean-blue eyes. She possesses a magnificent, glowing head of hair that reaches down to her feet, shining like liquid gold or fire in the light. Her hands are brown and work-hardened.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 12 LORNA COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P10](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P17](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P18](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0018)_

## Personality

Lorna Vane possesses a sharp wit, though she does not seem particularly inclined toward socializing. Guided by a principle instilled in her to fulfill any accepted duty regardless of the outcome, she is skilled in fine hand-stitching and embroidery. She strongly desires to become a mother, and also plans to move to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) in the autumn to study nursing and build her future.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P17](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P12](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P28](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P27](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P32](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0032)_

## History

Lorna Vane's life was shaped by a history of hardship and grief, having lost her brother when she was twelve and finding her father's hanged body at age fourteen. She spent a year at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) and eventually taught at the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) school. Lorna formed a friendship with her neighbor [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), though she initially harbored feelings of envy and resentment toward Nell's happiness until she confessed her bitterness and the two became lifelong friends. When writer [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) stayed in the area, he was struck by Lorna's beauty, and she secretly fell in love with him before his cold departure left her heartbroken. Lorna later traveled to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) to secure surgery for the man she believed to be her husband, Rufus, only to discover that the man she had been married to for twelve years was actually his cousin, [Laurence Vane](../character/laurence.md). Upon returning home, Lorna was reunited with Adrian, who declared his love for her. As the couple planned their future together, Lorna shared that Adrian intended to buy Nell's former cottage to use for their summer holidays.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P9](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P46](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P58](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0058), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020), +40 more_

## Quotes

> "My loveliness is something I despise. My desire is that I had perpetually been as dark-skinned and ordinary as the darkest-skinned and most ordinary female in that fishing village across the way. So, how do you regard Miss Winifred?"
>
> — Lorna Vane — [v4 CHAPTER 10 LORNA VANE P31](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0031)

> "Had I been aware, I’d have left—I’d not have remained in this place to encounter him. You ought to have informed me. You weren’t being fair, Nell—oh, you weren’t being fair!"
>
> — Lorna Vane — [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P47](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0047)

> “Though I have resided beneath its roof for merely a month,” Lorna said, “my affection for it surpasses any love I felt for the house across the way, where my entire life was spent.”
>
> — Lorna Vane — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P3](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0003)

> "Nell prefers the pink ones, whereas Hugh favors the white. However, I desire the crimson ones. No other flower fulfills a particular longing within me the way they do."
>
> — Lorna Vane — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P5](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0005)

> "Its magnitude feels impossible—I fear giving it voice—or dwelling on it. I feel as though this is merely one more illusion born of this dwelling of phantoms, bound to disappear the moment I depart."
>
> — Lorna Vane — [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P29](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0029)

## Relationships

### [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/adrian-treleaven--lorna-vane.md)

Lorna met [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) when he took up lodging at the Vane home, immediately capturing his attention with her beauty. The two spent time together over the summer alongside mutual friends while Adrian worked on a book. Although Lorna was initially heartbroken after he left, Adrian eventually returned to declare his love for her, a affection she fully reciprocated.

### [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lorna-vane--rufus-vane.md)
